scope: Static identity frames for twelve real loose items. Actual visible top owner only. No new spawns, animation, stack-count artwork or runtime integration claim.

frames.description: A short cut sheaf with notched grain heads and stems gathered into one tie; no standing soil or growing leaves.
frames.realSource: Three opening ripe field rows yield one unit each; packed first, overflow left on the cut row.
frames.actualUse: Eat for 2d4 healing or cook into toasted emberwheat.
frames.limits: No LightSourcePart. No planted-row identity, light halo, or promise of more than the real stack count.

frames.description: Dry cut grain with bent browned tips and a shorter gathered stem; distinct outline as well as color from raw grain.
frames.realSource: Cooking carried Emberwheat at a valid hot station replaces it with the same quantity of carried cooked food.
frames.actualUse: Eat for 3d4 healing and +20 heat resistance for 100 actor turns, replacing the previous prepared meal.
frames.limits: No flame, smoke, glowing coals, bread loaf or decorative duplicate beside the station.

frames.description: A detached golden hard-shell vessel, open dark neck above a rounded base; no vine, water surface or painted fill level.
frames.realSource: The opening ripe DrawgourdCrop releases one shell and one seed; Harvest leaves both on the bed, Gather tries to pack them.
frames.actualUse: Reusable water-only vessel: capacity three; fresh shells are empty. Fill, drink, water crops, transfer or douse through real actions.
frames.limits: Not stackable. One neutral silhouette for any valid charge count; no spring, automatic refill or implied water supply.

frames.description: One small pointed cream seed with a flat dry crease; deliberately much smaller than the vessel and no tilled soil behind it.
frames.realSource: One seed accompanies the ripe opening gourd's harvested shell.
frames.actualUse: Consume a carried seed to plant an empty prepared bed, underfoot or adjacent.
frames.limits: A loose seed is not an already planted crop or a packet promising several seeds.

frames.description: One broad pale cap above its short attached stem, separate from the three-cap living mushroom ring.
frames.realSource: Opening rings at (34,19) and (50,21) each yield two to four; source ring is removed, produce packs first or overflows.
frames.actualUse: Eat for 1d4 healing or cook into RoastedMushroom.
frames.limits: No poison, light, colony regrowth or multiple-unit promise is painted into this loose cap.

frames.description: Browned cap with up-curled ends and shortened cream stem; preserves the mushroom identity but changes its rim silhouette.
frames.realSource: Cooking carried Mushroom creates carried cooked food atomically, never an extra food owner beside the fire.
frames.actualUse: Eat for 3d4 healing and +20 acid resistance for 100 actor turns, replacing the previous prepared meal.
frames.limits: No poison, live fire, steam or stacked-meal promise.

frames.description: One oblique detached mineral shard with a short broken base; no three-pronged rock source or surrounding glow.
frames.realSource: The two opening quartz veins yield one or two units each and disappear when harvested; items pack first or overflow.
frames.actualUse: Forge infusion or consume one via CrackQuartz to create a separate temporary ground light.
frames.limits: Raw GlowQuartz has no LightSourcePart. CrackedGlowQuartz is a different non-takeable thirty-turn owner and is outside this atlas.

frames.description: Small cream medicine vessel with a brown stopper and worn rust paper band; opaque contents and no animated magic glow.
frames.realSource: One in the opening chest at (51,8); two in authored starting builds. Loose only after a real drop or transfer.
frames.actualUse: Consume by applying the 4d6+4 healing dose, or throw its real tonic payload.
frames.limits: No reusable empty-bottle owner, cure-all icon or transparent fill-level promise.

frames.description: Two irregular dry red-brown strips tied at one end; separated lower ends, no bones or fresh blood pool.
frames.realSource: One in the opening chest; two in starting builds; later visible through an actual drop or throw.
frames.actualUse: Eat for 3d4 healing; eligible hunting furrowstalkers can consume a ground unit as a finite diversion.
frames.limits: No promise that opening PetDog or Marlbacks obey bait. Throwing at a creature remains an attack.

frames.description: Compact uneven pressed red-clay lump with one matte clay-color ridge and flat dark underside; no flame or light.
frames.realSource: Two finite measures in the connected cellar supply crate; visible in the opening only after bringing and dropping them.
frames.actualUse: Two seal the opening well; one can smother existing flames without adding wetness. Other authored repairs use their own quantities.
frames.limits: Not a burning coal, ore vein, explosive or lasting fire-protection effect. Clay provenance remains gameplay data.

frames.description: Two short offset split wooden pieces with blunt cut ends and a clear horizontal gap; flat planks, not cylindrical logs or a full pallet.
frames.realSource: Dismantling the finite cellar timber pallet yields two units, packed first with genuine overflow if needed.
frames.actualUse: Repair supported wooden structures/gear, jam eligible traps, shape a haft, or add ten fuel to a finite cooking fire.
frames.limits: Art is an identity marker, not a count display. Feeding fuel does not ignite the fire. No new wood resource is created by drawing it.

frames.description: Low collapsed shale plates, folded tawny limbs and short pale claws, with an off-center blunt head; no upright living pose or embedded equipment.
frames.realSource: Actual opening Scrabbler/Gleaner deaths have a seventy-percent corpse chance, subject to corpse suppression; corpse records SourceBlueprint and SourceID.
frames.actualUse: Carryable remains, weight ten. The unchanged native entity owns its persistence and interactions.
frames.limits: No default HarvestablePart, FoodPart, decay timer or stack. No promised meat, minerals, resurrection or fresh gore decal.
